title: Sell Mineral Rights in Youngstown, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Youngstown, PA | Marcellus Buyer
metaDescription: Youngstown, Westmoreland County mineral owner? We buy Marcellus interests directly and give you an honest read on your lease before any offer.
heroLead: Youngstown is a small borough in western Westmoreland County, not to be confused with the Ohio city of the same name, sitting inside productive Marcellus ground.
intro: We get the question a lot: is this the Youngstown in Ohio? It isn't. This Youngstown is a quiet borough in Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, and the mineral rights question here is entirely a Pennsylvania one, governed by Pennsylvania law and Pennsylvania courthouse records.
If you hold minerals under a parcel here, we'll treat your interest the way we'd want ours treated: reviewed carefully before any number gets discussed.

sections.heading: Confirming What You Actually Own
paragraphs: Because there's a much larger, better-known Youngstown across the state line, we've seen owners occasionally confuse which county's records apply to their interest, especially if a family moved between Pennsylvania and Ohio at some point. We always confirm your parcel sits in Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania before doing anything else.
From there, we trace title through the Westmoreland County recorder of deeds the same way we would for any parcel in this part of the state.

sections.heading: How Deductions Show Up on a Typical Statement
paragraphs: Most leases in this part of Westmoreland County were signed with standard post-production deduction language, meaning gathering, compression, and marketing costs come out before your royalty is calculated. Pennsylvania's Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act only requires the check stay above one-eighth net, so those deductions are usually legal even when they feel steep.
If you've never had someone actually explain the math behind your statement, we're glad to walk through it, no cost, no obligation.

sections.heading: One Owner or Several, We'll Work With Your Situation
paragraphs: Some Youngstown-area interests we've reviewed belong to a single owner; others are split five or six ways among cousins who barely know each other anymore. Either way, we can structure a deal that fits your family's actual situation instead of forcing everyone into one process.

faqs.question: Is this the same Youngstown as the one in Ohio?
faqs.answer: No. This is a small borough in Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania. We confirm the correct county and state before reviewing any interest.

faqs.question: What deductions are legal on a Pennsylvania royalty check?
faqs.answer: Operators can generally deduct reasonable post-production costs, gathering, compression, marketing, as long as your payment stays above the one-eighth net floor set by the Guaranteed Minimum Royalty Act.

faqs.question: Can multiple family members sell their shares separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can work with each heir individually or coordinate one closing that pays each owner according to their confirmed share.
